meta_title_en: FAQ — Common Questions About Our Lab Services
meta_description_en: Find answers to common questions about our test packages, booking, results turnaround, and branches.

faq_items.question: How do I book a test?
faq_items.answer: You can book online through our website, call our hotline, or visit any of our branches in Nasr City or Maadi.

faq_items.question: How long does it take to receive my results?
faq_items.answer: Most results are ready within 24 hours. Some specialised tests may take 48–72 hours. You will be notified by SMS when your report is ready.

faq_items.question: Do I need to fast before a blood test?
faq_items.answer: Fasting for 8–12 hours is required for glucose, lipid panel, and metabolic tests. Your booking confirmation will specify fasting requirements for your chosen test.
